text: The cat sat on the mat. The big cat chased a small bird across the yard. A cat was seen near the old house.
She ran to the store quickly. He ran a large company for years. The children ran around the park laughing.
The man gave Mary a beautiful book about history. The old man walked slowly down the long road. A tall man was standing near the door.
The children were playing in the park when it started raining. The children built a small house out of boxes. Three children sat quietly and read their books.
He said that he would not go. She said nothing about the problem. They said the new building was too large.
The dog kept barking at the empty room. A small dog sat by the door. The dog was taken to the park by the children.
She wanted to build a new house near the river. They decided to build the wall higher. The house was built last year by a small company.
The teacher asked the students to write an essay. The students wanted to write a long story. He could not write because his hand was broken.
The book was old and the cover was torn. She read the book in one day. He gave the book to the teacher. A new book about birds appeared in the store.
The flowers in the garden were blooming despite the cold weather. She picked the flowers and put them on the table. Beautiful flowers grew near the old wall.
The company announced it would hire more workers. A large company was built from nothing. The small company made good products for years.
He walked to the door and opened it slowly. She walked quickly through the park. They walked along the river for a long time.
The water was cold and clear. She drank the water slowly. Cold water ran down the old wall. The water in the lake was very clean.
He wanted to take the children to the park. She took a long walk along the beach. The dog was taken home by the man. They took the old road through the hills.
She looked at the bird outside the window. He looked tired after the long day. The children looked happy when they saw the dog. They looked around the room carefully.
